reasoning: @LysandreJik is a core HF maintainer, but adding the same senior maintainers to every change is exactly the pattern that leads to review fatigue. For the transformers module specifically, @thomwolf has 26.4% ownership across 102 commits going back to November 2018, compared to @LysandreJik's 1.2% across 5 commits starting March 2020. @thomwolf is the right person for this specific change, not just a default approver. The PR removed a clone().detach() call on a tensor that was then mutated in-place via label assignment. A reviewer with deeper history on the data-collator path would more likely have caught the in-place mutation interaction.
cost_of_gap: Fourteen days after merge, issue #8619 was filed: "DataCollatorForLanguageModeling modifies input_ids via labels variable." The bug was traced to a removed clone().detach() call. From the original PR review thread, the cloning step was discussed and removed as feeling "more like a reflex than something really useful." A reviewer with hands-on history on this exact file would likely have spotted the in-place mutation risk before merge. Fixed in #8621.
